purpose: Stills of the break-room set for SH090 and SH100. The set was staged and verified numerically on 2026-10-16 but never seen; this spec drives the EXISTING harness (Python/render_prototypes.py) via its `spec` request override, so no second copy of the renderer exists.

render_tier.name: prototype
render_tier.method_note: Same method and same reason as the prototype spec: MRQ derives its frame range from a LevelSequence's playback range, and a still must not mutate a shared sequence.
render_tier.filmback_note: 35 x 19.6875 is exactly 1.77778 (16:9). Not optional - take_high_res_screenshot constrains the capture to the CAMERA's filmback aspect. Python/build_breakroom_scene.py now writes this filmback onto each Cam_BR_* camera so the request actually comes back 1280x720 instead of 1012x720.
render_tier.output_note: PNGs are local regenerable output and are NOT versioned (.gitignore excludes /Saved/* except Audit json|md|txt). The render report IS the evidence.

level.name: L_Toon_Shot_BreakRoom
level.why_no_ground_plane: The prototype spec drops a 200000uu Engine plane to catch the shadow terminator. This is an interior with its own floor mesh (BR_Shell), so an engine plane would poke through it.

shots.name: break_room_establish
shots.framing_intent: Wide establishing down the room at the counter run. This still is the gate for the whole set: if the room does not read, nothing downstream is worth lighting.
judge: does the counter run read as the back wall of the room
is the espresso machine inside the frame and not clipped
do the three practicals separate the counter band from the shelf wall
is anything poking through a wall

shots.name: coffee_machine
shots.framing_intent: Three-quarter close on the espresso machine with the mug in the foreground. The subject of this shot is a prop, so the test is whether the prop reads against the wall behind it.
judge: does the machine silhouette separate from the cabinets behind it
is the machine still seated on the counter (no float, no sink)
is the 15.6uu counter top visible under it

shots.name: spider_reveal_room
shots.framing_intent: The reveal framing with the room EMPTY. This is deliberately a room-only pass: Spider_Deform_v2 is imported and material-bound but never posed, and Docs/CAST_RIGS_2026-10-16.md says SH110 must not be lit or rendered until the creature is in it. It exists to check the framing, not the shot.
judge: does the counter run lead the eye from the reveal position
is there depth for a creature to move in
shots.gate: NOT the SH110 shot. Do not attach this still to the sequence.

known_limits_at_time_of_writing: SH110 is staged but must not ship: the spider is unposed and its rig is bound, not animated.
The room carries no character. SH090/SH100 read as an empty set until a rig is placed in them.

Levels are built from the ZMJ break-room kit at its own authored scale (111.2 x 54.6 x 60uu). Props from the KS/SG/Osc/KMP kits are deliberately excluded for scale reasons - see breakroom_stage.v1.json 'unplaced'.
